messages:
Priya (CSM): Heads-up — Skyline onboarding: our perf signals show 95th percentile latency spikes in prod and token costs creeping up. I want to propose a small proactive pilot: int8 quantization, a model-variant swap for tail requests, and a routing canary (low % traffic) to measure impact. 

Javier (Infra): +1. Can you drop the baseline metrics and a sample routing snippet? I can stand up a canary pool.

Priya (CSM): Baseline notes: p95 ~ 420ms, p50 ~ 85ms, token usage per session +18% MoM. Error budget still ok but margin shrinking. Proposed approach:
- Step A: Post-train int8 (opt-qt) on their current model class.
- Step B: Add "compact" model variant for tail inference (redwood-compact-v2).
- Step C: Routing policy: route 5% traffic to compact for 48h, monitor quality and latency.

Sam (Optimize Eng): Makes sense. From our bench, int8 should give ~1.5-1.8x throughput improvement and lower GPU hours. We'll include a quality harness (intent-F1, hallucination check, BLEU-ish for structured outputs).

Marta (Skyline): Quick question — how much risk of hallucination increases with int8? We're handling PII and compliance-sensitive replies.

Priya (CSM): Good call. We'll gate by specific rollback criteria: if intent-F1 on the customer eval set drops >2% OR hallucination rate (measured by our detectors on the eval set) increases by >1.5x, we rollback immediately. All logs go to their secure S3 bucket (KMS-protected).

Javier (Infra): Sample routing config to seed the canary:
```json
{
  "route_name": "skyline-compact-canary",
  "variant": "redwood-compact-v2",
  "weight": 0.05,
  "duration": "48h",
  "health_checks": {"intent_f1_threshold": 0.98, "latency_p95_reduction_target": 0.8},
  "rollback_on": ["quality_drop", "error_rate_increase"]
}
```

OpsBot: Ticket CS-4981 created and assigned to @Javier and @Sam. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-4981

Sam (Optimize Eng): I'll schedule the canary tomorrow 10:00 PT. Need ~2k redacted prompts + expected outputs from @Marta to seed the eval and latency/cost baselines. :clock10: 

Marta (Skyline): I'll export a de-identified sample set and share via secure folder — should have it EOD today.

Priya (CSM): Next steps: 1) Marta provides redacted samples; 2) Sam runs int8 build + compact variant canary; 3) run A/B for 48h collecting p50/p95 latency, token cost, intent-F1, hallucination rate; 4) review Fri 9am PT and decide rollout. Looping in Renewal: @Ethan (Renewals) — this is a proactive ops move to reduce renewal risk tied to perf.

Ethan (Renewals): Thanks — noted on the account health board. If the pilot shows <5% quality delta and p95 improves, we'll highlight this in the renewal pack.

Priya (CSM): Great — capturing feedback and enablement items: "runbook for canary", "customer eval set and thresholds", "visibility in Console per-route metrics", and "customer-facing summary for renewal team". Will follow up with the runbook link once CS-4981 has the steps. :white_check_mark:
